pages.text: Robbie was a raccoon who lived in a cozy hollow tree in the forest. He had the most curious mind and the cleverest paws of any raccoon around. Everything interested him!
One morning, Robbie heard a strange sound - tick-tick-scratch-scratch. "What could that be?" he wondered. His curious nature wouldn't let him ignore it!
Robbie followed the sound to an old log. A squirrel was trying to open it but couldn't! "Let me try," said Robbie. He used his clever paws to feel along the log.
Robbie's sensitive paws found a small latch hidden under the bark! He pressed and twisted with his nimble fingers. Click! The log opened like a treasure chest.
Inside were all the shiny pebbles and treasures Squirrel had collected! "I couldn't remember how to open it!" she said. "Thank you, Robbie! Your curious paws saved the day!"
From that day on, Robbie learned that being curious and using his clever paws to explore helped him solve problems and help friends. There was always something new to discover in the forest!
One autumn morning, all the acorns stored for winter had disappeared! "Someone took them!" cried Squirrel. "No, I bet they fell!" said Mouse. Everyone was upset and confused.
Robbie put on his special detective vest with his magnifying glass. "Let's not guess," he said calmly. "Let's look carefully and find out what really happened."
Robbie examined the empty stump with his magnifying glass. He saw tiny scratches, some broken twigs, and small tracks leading away. "Interesting!" he said, writing notes.
Following the tracks carefully, Robbie led his friends through the forest. The path went down a hill, around a big rock, and right to... a fallen tree! The tree had rolled down the hill.
"The tree must have fallen during the storm last night!" said Robbie. "When it rolled down the hill, it carried all the acorns with it. Nobody took them - they just went for a ride!"
Everyone worked together to gather the acorns back up. "Thank you, Robbie!" said Squirrel. "You looked carefully instead of guessing. That's how we found the real answer!" Robbie smiled proudly.
